release_notes: Build 57 fixes the remaining Library recovery case where installed Projects exist but the reusable quiz question Library is still empty.
Recovery now treats quiz_questions as the actual question Library instead of using project rows as proof that Library migration succeeded.

When the installed database has Projects but no quiz questions, the app searches migration markers, development checkouts, backups and bounded user-drive locations for the richest legacy question database.
The missing quiz_questions data is merged into the installed database instead of replacing the whole database, so existing installed Project rows are preserved.
Quiz History, history questions and upload-journal rows are recovered alongside the question Library when those installed tables are still empty.
A SQLite backup is created before the merge and the import is verified inside a transaction before it is committed.
A new installed-question-library-recovery-v3-diagnostics.json report records the selected source and row counts without storing API credentials.
